title: Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebab
description: A flavorful and tender lamb kebab dish from Saudi Arabia, served with a side of tangy sauce.

ingredients.name: Arabian Spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, coriander, and turmeric

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together Arabian Spices, Lemon Juice, and Olive Oil.
Add the cubed lamb to the marinade and mix until coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Transfer the kebabs to a serving platter and brush with Saudi Arabian Burger Sauce.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
